Eight painted views with alternating heel contacts, bent passing knees and toe push-off. The same travelled distance drives both feet; turning keeps the current phase.

Base walking only: 128 movement drawings. Empty-handed standing, tools and equipped costumes retain their own art. These generated painted cycles are reviewed sprites, not a motion-captured anatomical rig. Full cycle: 1.8 world units. No external assets or account needed.
